data.title: 克洛伊 · 夏日祭的草莓面具
data.description: 【冬木夏日祭·黄昏】克洛伊穿着草莓粉浴衣站在面具摊前，先把一枚狐狸面具扣到自己脸上，又从摊主手里抢到最后一枚草莓糖；她掀开面具对镜头得意眨眼。
data.action: 祭典面具摊戴狐狸面具抢到最后一枚草莓糖，掀面具朝镜头得意眨眼
data.mood: 把胜负心变成节日可爱战利品
data.promptProse: At the festival mask stall, Chloe von Einzbern lifts her fox mask to reveal a delighted orange-eyed wink after winning the last strawberry candy. Her securely wrapped strawberry-pink floral yukata, cream obi and sandals retain the summer outfit. The horizontal medium view includes the candy and hanging masks receding beside her. Lantern glow warms her brown skin and mask edge, contrasting with blue evening beyond the stall's sheltered counter.
